prompt: Which sentence says: Once you have decided, do not change it?
options: 一旦你决定了，就不要改变。
一旦你决定了，不要就改变。
zh: 一旦你决定了，就不要改变。
en: Once you have decided, do not change it.
explain: 就 comes before the result.

en: Once it gets dark, we will go home.
wrong: 如果一旦天黑，我们就回家。
explain: 一旦 already means once or if; do not add 如果.

prompt: Which sentence says: Once you have a problem, call me?
options: 一旦你有问题，就给我打电话。
一旦你有问题，给我就打电话。
zh: 一旦你有问题，就给我打电话。
en: Once you have a problem, call me.
explain: 就 comes right before the result.

zh: 一旦下雪，学校就会放假。
en: Once it snows, the school will have a holiday.
explain: 一旦 + condition, 就 + result.

en: Once she gets angry, she does not talk.
explain: 一旦 + condition, 就 + result.

zh: 一旦你累了，就休息一下。
en: Once you get tired, take a rest.
wrong: 一旦要是你累了，就休息一下。
explain: 一旦 already means once or if; do not add 要是.

zh: 他很努力，从而取得了好成绩。
en: He worked hard and so achieved good results.
explain: 从而 + result.

prompt: Which sentence says: He exercises every day and so stays healthy?
options: 他每天锻炼，从而保持健康。
他每天锻炼，保持从而健康。
zh: 他每天锻炼，从而保持健康。
en: He exercises every day and so stays healthy.
explain: 从而 comes right after the first action and before the result.

zh: 天气很冷，因而他穿了很多衣服。
en: It was very cold, so he put on a lot of clothes.
explain: 因而 gives the result of a reason.

zh: 她多听多说，从而提高了水平。
en: She listens and speaks more, and so has raised her level.
explain: 从而 adds a second step that follows from the first.

en: He got sick, so he did not go.
wrong: 他生病了，因而所以没去。
explain: 因而 already means so; do not add 所以.

prompt: Which sentence says: Tomorrow we will either take the train or take a plane?
options: 明天我们或是坐火车，或是坐飞机。
明天我们或是坐火车，还是坐飞机。
zh: 明天我们或是坐火车，或是坐飞机。
en: Tomorrow we will either take the train or take a plane.
explain: 或是 pairs with 或是.

zh: 明天他或是来，或是打电话。
en: Tomorrow he will either come or call.
explain: 或是 + choice, 或是 + choice.

en: You can have tea or coffee.
explain: 或是 joins choices in a statement.

prompt: Which sentence says: At the weekend he either plays football or plays basketball?
options: 周末他或是踢足球，或是打篮球。
周末他还是踢足球，还是打篮球。
zh: 周末他或是踢足球，或是打篮球。
en: At the weekend he either plays football or plays basketball.
explain: In a statement use 或是, not 还是.

zh: 明天我或是游泳，或是跑步。
en: Tomorrow I will either swim or run.
wrong: 明天我或是游泳，或是还是跑步。
explain: Do not put 还是 next to 或是.

zh: 晚上他或是看电视，或是玩游戏。
en: In the evening he either watches TV or plays games.
explain: 或是 + choice, 或是 + choice.

en: Going or not going, either is fine.
explain: X也好，Y也好.

prompt: Which sentence says: Whether it is rice or noodles, I like them both?
options: 吃米饭也好，吃面条也好，我都喜欢。
吃米饭也好，吃面条好，我都喜欢。
zh: 吃米饭也好，吃面条也好，我都喜欢。
en: Whether it is rice or noodles, I like them both.
explain: Each part ends with 也好.

zh: 坐车也好，走路也好，我都行。
en: Whether by bus or on foot, I am fine with either.
explain: 都 sums up both choices.

zh: 大人也好，孩子也好，都喜欢他。
en: Whether adults or children, all like him.
wrong: 大人也好，还是孩子也好，都喜欢他。
explain: Do not put 还是 between the two 也好 parts.

prompt: Which sentence says: Whether in the day or at night, he is working?
options: 白天也好，晚上也好，他都在工作。
白天也好，晚上也好，他在工作都。
zh: 白天也好，晚上也好，他都在工作。
en: Whether in the day or at night, he is working.
explain: 都 goes before the verb in the result.

zh: 贵也好，便宜也好，我都买。
en: Whether it is expensive or cheap, I will buy it.
explain: 也好 needs 都 in the result.

en: Whether on foot or by car, it is fine.
explain: …也好，…也好，都 + result.

en: Counting me, there are five people in all.
explain: 加上 = adding.

zh: 我们买了书、笔以及本子。
en: We bought books, pens and notebooks.
wrong: 我们买了书、笔以及和本子。
explain: 以及 already joins the last item.

prompt: Which sentence says: On the table there are milk, bread and fruit?
options: 桌子上有牛奶、面包以及水果。
桌子上有牛奶、面包、水果以及。
zh: 桌子上有牛奶、面包以及水果。
en: On the table there are milk, bread and fruit.
explain: 以及 comes before the last item.

zh: 他很累，加上天气太热，所以不想吃饭。
en: He is tired, and on top of that it is too hot, so he does not want to eat.
explain: 加上 adds one more reason.

zh: 爸爸、妈妈以及哥哥都来了。
en: Dad, Mom and my older brother have all come.
explain: 以及 joins the last two things in a list.

zh: 我很忙，加上孩子生病，所以今天不能去。
en: I am busy, and on top of that my child is ill, so I cannot go today.
wrong: 我很忙，加上和孩子生病，所以今天不能去。
explain: 加上 adds a reason by itself; do not add 和.

prompt: Which sentence says: However busy I am, I will still exercise?
en: However busy I am, I will still exercise.
explain: 也 goes before 要 in the result.

en: However hard the problem is, he will still work hard.
explain: 再 + adjective, 也 + result.

en: However hot it is, he does not turn on the air conditioning.
explain: 再 + adjective, 也 + result.

en: However tired he is, he does not rest.
explain: 再 already means however; do not add 非常.

en: Without effort, there is no success.
explain: 没有 A，就没有 B.

prompt: Which sentence says: Without friends, there is no happiness?
en: Without friends, there is no happiness.
explain: The second part is also 没有.

en: Without air, there is no life.
wrong: 没有空气，就不没有生命。
explain: No 不 before 没有.

prompt: Which sentence says: Without study, there is no progress?
en: Without study, there is no progress.
explain: 就 comes before the second 没有.

en: Without water, there are no fish.
explain: 没有 A，就没有 B.

en: Without effort, there is no success.
explain: 没有 A，就没有 B.

en: Without electricity, there is no light.
explain: Keep 就 right before 没有.

prompt: Which sentence says: He leaves early so as to catch the train?
options: 他早点出门，以便赶上火车。
他早点出门，便以赶上火车。
zh: 他早点出门，以便赶上火车。
en: He leaves early so as to catch the train.
explain: 以便 + the aim.

zh: 请告诉我你的电话，以便我能找到你。
en: Please tell me your phone number so that I can find you.
explain: 以便 + purpose, after the action.

prompt: Which sentence says: I buy some more water so that I can drink it on the way?
options: 我多买一些水，以便路上能喝。
我多买一些水，路上能喝以便。
zh: 我多买一些水，以便路上能喝。
en: I buy some more water so that I can drink it on the way.
explain: 以便 comes before the purpose.

zh: 她努力工作，为的是买房子。
en: She works hard in order to buy a house.
explain: The action comes first, then 为的是 + purpose.

zh: 请写下你的名字，以便我能记住。
en: Please write down your name so that I can remember.
wrong: 请写下你的名字，以便为了我能记住。
explain: 以便 already means so that; do not add 为了.

en: We take the school as the centre.
explain: 以 + thing + 为 + role.

en: He takes getting into university as his goal.
wrong: 他以考上大学为是目标。
explain: 以 … 为 … has no 是.

prompt: Which sentence says: The school has the library as its centre?
en: The school has the library as its centre.
explain: Say 以 … 为中心, not 以 … 是中心.

en: She takes becoming a doctor as her goal.
explain: 以 + thing + 为 + centre / goal.

en: He takes learning Chinese well as his goal.
explain: 以 … 为目标 names a goal.

zh: 我们以提高水平为目标。
en: We take raising our level as our goal.
wrong: 我们以提高水平是为目标。
explain: Do not add 是 inside 以 … 为 ….

zh: 我给他钱，他反而生气了。
en: I gave him money, but he got angry instead.
explain: 反而 = the opposite happened.

prompt: Which sentence says: The weather did not get better; instead it got colder?
options: 天气不但没好，反而更冷了。
天气不但没好，更冷反而了。
zh: 天气不但没好，反而更冷了。
en: The weather did not get better; instead it got colder.
explain: 反而 comes before 更冷.

prompt: Which sentence says: After taking the medicine, he felt even worse instead?
options: 吃了药，他反而更难受了。
zh: 吃了药，他反而更难受了。
en: After taking the medicine, he felt even worse instead.
explain: 反而 needs a result that goes against what you expect.

zh: 他学得很努力，成绩反而更差了。
en: He studied very hard, but his grades got worse instead.
explain: 反而 shows the opposite of what you expect.

zh: 我不但没睡好，反而更累了。
en: I did not sleep well; instead I got more tired.
explain: 不但没 …，反而 ….

zh: 天不但没热，反而更冷了。
en: It did not get warmer; instead it got colder.
wrong: 天不但没热，反而很更冷了。
explain: 更 already compares; do not add 很.

en: Hurry up, otherwise we will be late.
explain: 不然 = otherwise.

zh: 多穿一点衣服，不然容易感冒。
en: Wear more clothes, otherwise it is easy to catch a cold.
wrong: 多穿一点衣服，不然要是容易感冒。
explain: 不然 already means otherwise.

en: Or shall we go by metro?
explain: 要不 suggests another idea.

prompt: Which sentence says: Drink more water, or you will feel unwell?
options: 多喝水，不然你会不舒服。
不然你会不舒服，多喝水。
zh: 多喝水，不然你会不舒服。
en: Drink more water, or you will feel unwell.
explain: Put the warning after the thing you should do.

en: How about going tomorrow instead?
explain: 要不 + idea + 吧.

en: Be careful, or you will get sick.
wrong: 你小心点，不然要不会生病。
explain: Use 不然 or 要不, not both.

en: He is still young after all.
explain: 毕竟 goes before the verb or adjective.

prompt: Which sentence says: A child is a child after all?
en: A child is a child after all.
explain: 毕竟 comes before 是.

en: He is only a student after all.
explain: No 都 after 毕竟.

prompt: Which sentence says: He is new after all; do not be angry with him?
options: 他毕竟是新来的，别生他的气。
他是新来的毕竟，别生他的气。
zh: 他毕竟是新来的，别生他的气。
en: He is new after all; do not be angry with him.
explain: 毕竟 goes before the verb or noun phrase.

zh: 这件事毕竟不容易，你要理解他。
en: After all, this is not easy; you should understand him.
explain: 毕竟 reminds the listener of a basic fact.

en: She is your mother after all.
explain: 毕竟 comes before the verb.

en: He is young after all, and has no experience.
wrong: 他毕竟虽然年轻，没有经验。
explain: 毕竟 does not go with 虽然.

zh: 我想他会来，他果然来了。
en: I thought he would come, and sure enough he came.
explain: 果然 = as expected.

prompt: Which sentence says: The weather forecast said rain, and sure enough it rained?
options: 天气预报说有雨，果然下雨了。
天气预报说有雨，下雨果然了。
zh: 天气预报说有雨，果然下雨了。
en: The weather forecast said rain, and sure enough it rained.
explain: 果然 comes before the verb.

en: This restaurant is indeed very tasty.
wrong: 这家饭店果然是很好吃。
explain: No 是 before the adjective.

prompt: Which sentence says: My friend said this shop is good; I went, and sure enough it was good?
options: 朋友说这家店很好，我去了，果然很好。
朋友说这家店很好，我去了，很好果然。
zh: 朋友说这家店很好，我去了，果然很好。
en: My friend said this shop is good; I went, and sure enough it was good.
explain: 果然 goes before the verb or adjective.

zh: 他说他会赢，结果果然赢了。
en: He said he would win, and sure enough he won.
explain: 果然 = it turned out as expected.

zh: 我猜他会迟到，他果然迟到了。
en: I guessed he would be late, and sure enough he was late.
explain: 果然 follows an expectation.

zh: 我说他会赢，他果然赢了。
en: I said he would win, and sure enough he won.
wrong: 我说他会赢，他居然果然赢了。
explain: 果然 is for what you expected; 居然 is for a surprise. Do not use both.

en: Surprisingly, he does not know me.
explain: 居然 = to one's surprise.

prompt: Which sentence says: He actually does not know what date it is today?
options: 他居然不知道今天是几号。
他不知道居然今天是几号。
zh: 他居然不知道今天是几号。
en: He actually does not know what date it is today.
explain: 居然 goes before the verb.

zh: 这么简单的题，你居然做错了。
en: You actually got such an easy question wrong.
explain: 居然 shows surprise.

en: She actually went alone.
explain: 居然 comes before the verb.

en: He can actually speak Chinese.
explain: 居然 and 竟然 mean the same; use only one.

en: He seems very tired.
explain: 似乎 = seems.

prompt: Which sentence says: It seems he did not hear?
en: It seems he did not hear.
explain: 仿佛 comes before 没.

en: He seems not very happy.
explain: Use one word for 'seems'.

prompt: Which sentence says: He seems not to want to go?
en: He seems not to want to go.
explain: 似乎 comes before the verb or phrase it guesses about.

en: He looks as if he has fallen asleep.
explain: 仿佛 … 似的 = as if.

en: There seems to be nobody here.
explain: 似乎 makes a careful guess.

en: She acts as if she did not hear.
wrong: 她仿佛好像没听见似的。
explain: Use one of 仿佛 and 好像, not both.

zh: 从他的成绩来看，他学习很努力。
en: Judging from his grades, he studies very hard.
explain: 从 + what you judge by + 来看.

zh: 从我的经验来看，这个办法不错。
en: From my experience, this method is good.
wrong: 从我的经验来看了，这个办法不错。
explain: No 了 after 来看.

prompt: Which sentence says: Judging from the price, this phone is expensive?
options: 从价格来看，这个手机很贵。
从来看价格，这个手机很贵。
zh: 从价格来看，这个手机很贵。
en: Judging from the price, this phone is expensive.
explain: 来看 closes the 从 phrase.

zh: 从他的表情来看，他很高兴。
en: Judging from his expression, he is very happy.
explain: 从 + evidence + 来看.

zh: 从这张照片来看，他很年轻。
en: Judging from this photo, he is young.
explain: 从 + evidence + 来看, judgement.

zh: 从天气来看，明天不会下雨。
en: Judging from the weather, it will not rain tomorrow.
wrong: 从天气是来看，明天不会下雨。
explain: Do not put 是 inside 从 … 来看.

en: Take him, for example: he loves sport.
explain: 拿 + example + 来说.

prompt: Which sentence says: Take study, for example: he is better than me?
en: Take study, for example: he is better than me.
explain: 来说

en: Take the north, for example: it is cold there.
wrong: 拿北边来说，那里是很冷。
explain: No 是 before the adjective.

prompt: Which sentence says: Take my family, for example: everyone loves reading?
options: 拿我家来说，每个人都爱看书。
拿来说我家，每个人都爱看书。
zh: 拿我家来说，每个人都爱看书。
en: Take my family, for example: everyone loves reading.
explain: 来说 closes the 拿 phrase.

zh: 拿这件衣服来说，价格很便宜。
en: Take this piece of clothing, for example: the price is cheap.
explain: 拿 + case + 来说.

zh: 拿汉语来说，我学了三年。
en: Take Chinese, for example: I have studied it for three years.
explain: 拿 + case + 来说, then a statement.

zh: 拿她来说，她每天都很忙。
en: Take her, for example: she is busy every day.
wrong: 拿她来说看，她每天都很忙。
explain: 拿 … 来说 is a full pattern; do not add 看.

en: In his view, this is easy.
explain: 在 + person + 看来.

prompt: Which sentence says: In my view, he is right?
en: In my view, he is right.
explain: 在 + person + 看来.

prompt: Which sentence says: In the children's view, playing is more fun than studying?
options: 在孩子们看来，玩比学习有意思。
在看来孩子们，玩比学习有意思。
zh: 在孩子们看来，玩比学习有意思。
en: In the children's view, playing is more fun than studying.
explain: 看来 closes the 在 phrase.

zh: 在妈妈看来，我还是个孩子。
en: In Mom's view, I am still a child.
explain: 在 + person + 看来.

zh: 在我们看来，这个办法不错。
en: In our view, this way is good.
explain: 在 + person + 看来, opinion.

en: In everyone's view, he is very smart.
wrong: 在大家看来的，他很聪明。
explain: Do not put 的 after 看来.

en: In short, this matter is important.
explain: 总之 sums up.

prompt: Which sentence says: He is late every day; from this it can be seen that he does not work hard?
options: 他每天都迟到，由此可见，他不努力。
他每天都迟到，可见由此，他不努力。
zh: 他每天都迟到，由此可见，他不努力。
en: He is late every day; from this it can be seen that he does not work hard.
explain: 由此可见 is a set phrase; keep the order.

zh: 由此可见，学习需要时间。
en: From this it can be seen that learning takes time.
explain: 由此可见 = from this it can be seen.

en: In short, this way is not very good.
explain: 总之 starts the closing sentence.

en: From this it can be seen that he is very smart.
wrong: 由此可见，所以他很聪明。
explain: 由此可见 already leads to the conclusion; do not add 所以.

prompt: Which sentence says: Up to now, we have bought three books?
options: 到现在为止，我们已经买了三本书。
从现在为止，我们已经买了三本书。
zh: 到现在为止，我们已经买了三本书。
en: Up to now, we have bought three books.
explain: 为止 goes with 到.

zh: 到五点为止，我都在学校。
en: Until five o'clock, I will be at school.
wrong: 到五点为止了，我都在学校。
explain: No 了 after 为止.

prompt: Which sentence says: Up to yesterday, we have already studied ten lessons?
options: 到昨天为止，我们已经学了十课。
从昨天为止，我们已经学了十课。
zh: 到昨天为止，我们已经学了十课。
en: Up to yesterday, we have already studied ten lessons.
explain: 为止 only goes with 到, not 从.

zh: 到今年为止，他已经工作了十年。
en: Up to this year, he has already worked for ten years.
explain: 到 + time + 为止.

en: The match goes on until three in the afternoon.
explain: 到 + time + 为止 marks an end point.

zh: 到星期五为止，你都可以来。
en: Up to Friday, you can come at any time.
wrong: 从到星期五为止，你都可以来。
explain: 为止 goes with 到 only; do not add 从.

zh: 他凭自己的努力成功了。
en: He succeeded through his own effort.
explain: 凭 + what it rests on.

prompt: Which sentence says: On what grounds do you say this?
en: On what grounds do you say this?
explain: 凭什么 asks on what grounds.

prompt: Which sentence says: He solved the problem by experience?
en: He solved the problem by experience.
explain: 凭 goes before the verb.

zh: 她凭借自己的努力成功了。
en: She succeeded by means of her own effort.
explain: 凭借 is the formal form of 凭.

en: He got the chance through hard work.
explain: 凭 + what it rests on + verb.

zh: 他凭自己的经验解决了问题。
en: He solved the problem on the strength of his own experience.
wrong: 他凭用自己的经验解决了问题。
explain: 凭 already means by; do not add 用.

en: According to the rules, we must come early.
explain: 依据 + rule.

prompt: Which sentence says: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow?
options: 依据天气预报，明天会下雨。
天气预报依据，明天会下雨。
zh: 依据天气预报，明天会下雨。
en: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.
explain: 依据 comes before what it rests on.

zh: 依据他的经验，这个办法可以用。
en: According to his experience, this method can be used.
wrong: 依据根据他的经验，这个办法可以用。
explain: 依据 and 根据 mean the same; use one.

prompt: Which sentence says: Based on these numbers, we can make a decision?
options: 依据这些数字，我们可以做出决定。
这些数字依据，我们可以做出决定。
zh: 依据这些数字，我们可以做出决定。
en: Based on these numbers, we can make a decision.
explain: 依据 comes first and the basis follows it.

zh: 依据规定，学生不能迟到。
en: According to the rules, students cannot be late.
explain: 依据 + basis, written style.

zh: 依据这些数据，他的看法是对的。
en: Based on these figures, his view is correct.
explain: 依据 + basis, then the conclusion.

zh: 依据新的规定，大家都要来。
en: According to the new rule, everyone must come.
wrong: 依据是新的规定，大家都要来。
explain: Do not put 是 after 依据.

zh: 我们靠自己的力量完成了工作。
en: We finished the work through our own strength.
explain: 靠 + what one relies on.

en: He lives by selling fruit.
